issue.standard_remedy: Consolidate tail suppliers into preferred suppliers
issue.summary: 131 of 173 suppliers share the last 20% of category spend

plan.diagnosis: Printed circuit assemblies category shows extreme fragmentation with 131 suppliers controlling only 20% of spend (USD 2,903,938), while 173 total suppliers generate a Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of 633, indicating highly dispersed purchasing power. The top supplier, Meridian Precision Components LLC, holds only 16.1% share, demonstrating lack of strategic consolidation and resulting in increased transactional costs, limited volume leverage, and excessive procurement overhead across multiple ERP systems.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct tail supplier spend analysis across all five ERPs (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Coupa) to identify the 131 tail suppliers and map their USD 2,903,938 spend by part number, delivery performance, and quality metrics
Issue RFQ to top 5 strategic suppliers including Meridian Precision Components LLC for tail spend consolidation, targeting 70-80% of the USD 2,903,938 tail spend with volume-based pricing tiers
Negotiate consolidation agreements with 2-3 preferred suppliers, securing minimum 8-12% volume discounts on redirected tail spend and standardized payment terms
Implement supplier rationalization by blocking 80-100 tail suppliers in all ERP systems and creating approved source lists for preferred suppliers
Execute phased transition of tail spend to consolidated suppliers with engineering validation for critical components and supplier performance scorecards

plan.expected_impact: Consolidating 70% of tail spend (USD 2,032,757) with preferred suppliers at 10% volume discount will yield USD 203,276 in annual savings, plus an estimated USD 150,000 reduction in procurement transactional costs from eliminating 90 supplier relationships.
kpis: Reduce supplier base from 173 to 60-70 suppliers within 6 months
Increase top 5 supplier concentration from current 16.1% top share to 60% aggregate share
Improve HHI from 633 to 1,200+ indicating healthier concentration
Achieve USD 203,276 in direct cost savings (10% of USD 2,032,757 consolidated tail spend)
Reduce procurement transactional costs by USD 150,000 annually
Decrease average PO processing time by 30% through reduced supplier complexity
risks: Supply continuity disruption if tail suppliers hold sole-source components or proprietary designs within the USD 2,903,938 spend
Preferred suppliers may lack capacity or technical capability to absorb additional USD 2,032,757 in volume
Engineering change management delays if component qualifications are required for supplier switches
Tail suppliers may hold long-term contracts or minimum purchase commitments preventing immediate exit
Multi-ERP environment complexity may cause data synchronization errors during supplier blocking and source list updates
Incumbent supplier relationship damage affecting the remaining 80% (USD 11,853,290) of category spend
erp_actions: SAP: Set posting block (SPERR field) in LFA1 and purchasing block (SPERM field) in LFM1 for 80-100 tail suppliers; update source list (EINA/EINE) with preferred suppliers only
Oracle EBS: Disable supplier sites in PO_VENDOR_SITES_ALL for tail suppliers; create Approved Supplier List entries and sourcing rules for consolidated suppliers
Dynamics 365: Set vendor on hold status for tail suppliers in Vendor master; configure trade agreements for volume pricing with preferred suppliers
NetSuite: Inactivate tail supplier vendor records; create item-supplier relationships and preferred vendor assignments for consolidated suppliers

Coupa: Remove tail suppliers from preferred supplier lists; update supplier information records with volume commitment terms and tiered pricing for consolidated suppliers; enable invoice matching only for approved source list
